---
title: "First cuts"
date: 2026-07-05
categories: [sawing, beginner]
---

First proper session at the bench. Just cutting pine offcuts to a knife line, over and
over.

The saw wanders the moment I stop paying attention — usually when I try to go faster.
Slowing down and letting the teeth do the work made an immediate difference. Started the
cut with a few light backstrokes to set the kerf, which stopped the blade jumping.

Not straight yet, but straighter by the end than the start. Good enough for one day.
